import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import json
import os
import re
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
SAMPLE_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/sampleSubmission.csv"
TRAIN_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/train/train.json"
TEST_FILE = f"{INPUT_DIR}/test.json"

os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

print("Loading training data...")
with open(TRAIN_FILE, "r") as f:
    train_data = json.load(f)
train_df = pd.DataFrame(train_data)

print("Loading test data...")
with open(TEST_FILE, "r") as f:
    test_data = json.load(f)
test_df = pd.DataFrame(test_data)

if os.path.exists(SAMPLE_FILE):
    sample_df = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_FILE)
    print(f"Sample columns: {sample_df.columns.tolist()}")


def clean_request_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text) or str(text).strip() == "":
        return ""
    text = str(text).lower()
    unicode_ctrl_chars = [
        "\u200b",
        "\u200c",
        "\u200d",
        "\u200e",
        "\u200f",
        "\u2009",
        "\u200a",
    ]
    for char in unicode_ctrl_chars:
        text = text.replace(char, "")
    text = text.replace("\t", " ")
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    for marker in [
        r"^edit:\s*",
        r"^update:\s*",
        r"^i\s+wanted\s+just",
        r"^hope this helps",
        r"^thanks\s*:.*$",
    ]:
        text = re.sub(marker, "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    for phrase in [
        r"^thank you!\s*",
        r"^pizza arrived!\s*",
        r"^delicious!\s*",
        r"^great service!\s*",
    ]:
        text = re.sub(phrase, "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    for pattern in [
        r"the\s+request\s+(?:failed|worked)$",
        r"\s*(?:delivered|arrived)\s+(?:for\s+)?me?",
        r"(?:edited|modified)\s+.*\bthanks\b",
    ]:
        text = re.sub(pattern, "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


text_col = "request_text_edit_aware"
train_text_raw = train_df[text_col].apply(clean_request_text)
test_text_raw = test_df[text_col].apply(clean_request_text)

tfidf_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=5000, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2
)
tfidf_train = tfidf_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_text_raw)
tfidf_test = tfidf_vectorizer.transform(test_text_raw)

X_train_text = tfidf_train.toarray()
X_test_text = tfidf_test.toarray()

subreddit_train = train_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].tolist()
subreddit_test = test_df["requester_subreddits_at_request"].tolist()

subreddit_terms_list = []
subreddit_terms_test_list = []
for sd in subreddit_train:
    cleaned = [str(x) if x is not None else "" for x in sd]
    subreddit_terms_list.append(" ".join(cleaned))
for sd in subreddit_test:
    cleaned = [str(x) if x is not None else "" for x in sd]
    subreddit_terms_test_list.append(" ".join(cleaned))

subreddit_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="word", token_pattern=r"\b\w+\b", min_df=1, max_features=500
)
subreddit_vectorizer.fit(subreddit_terms_list)
subreddit_train_vec = subreddit_vectorizer.transform(subreddit_terms_list)
subreddit_test_vec = subreddit_vectorizer.transform(subreddit_terms_test_list)

X_train_subreddit = subreddit_train_vec.toarray()
X_test_subreddit = subreddit_test_vec.toarray()

train_df["unix_timestamp"] = pd.to_numeric(
    train_df["unix_timestamp_of_request"], errors="coerce"
)
test_df["unix_timestamp"] = pd.to_numeric(
    test_df["unix_timestamp_of_request"], errors="coerce"
)
median_ts = train_df["unix_timestamp"].median()
train_df["unix_timestamp"] = train_df["unix_timestamp"].fillna(median_ts)
test_df["unix_timestamp"] = test_df["unix_timestamp"].fillna(median_ts)

train_doi = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(train_df["unix_timestamp"], unit="s"))
test_doi = pd.DatetimeIndex(pd.to_datetime(test_df["unix_timestamp"], unit="s"))

train_hour = train_doi.hour.values
test_hour = test_doi.hour.values

train_dow = train_doi.dayofweek.values
test_dow = test_doi.dayofweek.values

peak_hours = [18, 19, 20, 21, 22]
train_peak = (
    (train_hour > min(peak_hours)) | (train_hour >= max(peak_hours) - 1)
).astype(float)
test_peak = ((test_hour > min(peak_hours)) | (test_hour >= max(peak_hours) - 1)).astype(
    float
)

numeric_cols = [
    c
    for c in train_df.columns
    if any(
        term in c.lower()
        for term in ["downvote", "upvote", "comment", "post", "age", "timestamp"]
    )
]
common_numeric_cols = list(
    set(numeric_cols).intersection(test_df.select_dtypes(include=["number"]).columns)
)

if len(common_numeric_cols) > 0:
    X_train_num = train_df[common_numeric_cols].fillna(0).values.astype(float)
    X_test_num = test_df[common_numeric_cols].fillna(0).values.astype(float)
else:
    non_request_cols = [
        c
        for c in train_df.columns
        if "request_" not in c.lower() and c != "requester_received_pizza"
    ]
    X_train_num = train_df[non_request_cols].fillna(0).values.astype(float)
    X_test_num = test_df[non_request_cols].fillna(0).values.astype(float)

scaler = StandardScaler()
X_train_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_num)
X_test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_num)

X_train_all = np.hstack([X_train_scaled, X_train_text, X_train_subreddit])
X_test_all = np.hstack([X_test_scaled, X_test_text, X_test_subreddit])

X_train_all = np.hstack(
    [
        X_train_all,
        train_hour.reshape(-1, 1),
        train_dow.reshape(-1, 1),
        train_peak.reshape(-1, 1),
    ]
)
X_test_all = np.hstack(
    [
        X_test_all,
        test_hour.reshape(-1, 1),
        test_dow.reshape(-1, 1),
        test_peak.reshape(-1, 1),
    ]
)

label_col = "requester_received_pizza"
y_train = train_df[label_col].astype(int).values

# Perform train/val split to get proper hold-out set
X_train_split, X_val_split, y_train_split, y_val_split = train_test_split(
    X_train_all, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

model = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000, class_weight="balanced", random_state=42, solver="lbfgs"
)
model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

y_val_pred_prob = model.predict_proba(X_val_split)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val_split, y_val_pred_prob)
print(f"AUC-ROC on validation set: {val_auc:.6f}")

request_ids = test_df["request_id"].tolist()
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "request_id": request_ids,
        "requester_received_pizza": model.predict_proba(X_test_all)[:, 1],
    }
)
submission.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully")
